message: Lead reviewed current uncommitted FeedbackStore witness schema and APIs. Good direction: transactional SQLite admission/permit, separate persistent unresolved witnesses, exact connection/generation terminal match, do not infer completion from telemetry. Additional critical negative case: on FIRST rollout/server restart, existing 3.63 requests may have been dispatched before agent_execution_witness existed; an empty freshly migrated table is not proof of quiescence. Add an upgrade/drain/reconciliation barrier or explicit fail-closed protocol-epoch readiness before enabling corrections, including clients with old protocol and late replies. Audit nested SendCommandToProject/cross-project notification dispatch paths as they also transit ClientService and may use a source actor; avoid treating destination-agent targets as actor activity. Test prior-version in-flight operation + server restart and ensure correction cannot win. Keep recorded liveness statuses typed at boundaries (DB CHECK acceptable) instead of ambiguous string comparisons, preserve no-bypass for unknown receipts. No merge/deploy.
